name: Material Flow
description: A recurring movement of one material category between two entities, carrying monthly volume and value. Reified as a class because the flow itself has attributes the endpoints do not. Abstract class covering Inbound Flow, Outbound Flow, Inter Plant Flow. In the supply chain model: A Material Flow carries a Material Category (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
